Visit note | 2025-05-19 09:30 AM | Dr. Tahmina Begum, Dermatology | Patient: Mahfuz Faruque, 28, male. Mr. Faruque attends for review regarding marks left after pimples and spots on the back. He notes these spots flared after using a heavy face cream bought in Barishal. He works as a tailor and has Type 2 diabetes mellitus. He denies new widespread rashes, severe scaling, or itching elsewhere. On examination, there are about 11 inflamed spots on the face. His BP is 111/72 mmHg, pulse 92 bpm, and weight is 58 kg. Skin surrounding the lesions shows mild hyperpigmentation without active infection. Assessment: Acne vulgaris. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to wash the face twice daily with a gentle cleanser and do not squeeze spots. Follow-up in 2 months.
